flows.title: Share a lead capture form (Dubsado 2.0)
steps: Click the lead capture form you want to share.
Click the Sharing icon on the sidebar. If the icon is grayed out, click Save form first.
Copy either the Embed code, to display the form on your website, or the Direct link, to share it on social media, as a button or as a text link. Later changes to the form update both automatically.

flows.title: Map a custom URL to your own domain (Dubsado 2.0)
steps: This needs a CNAME record at your domain host — for example portal — whose value points to ssl.dubsado.com, created there and fully propagated, which can take up to 48 hours. Dubsado cannot create it for you.
In Dubsado, go to Settings >> Domain names.
Under Custom URL mapping, enter your new CNAME URL in the URL field, for example portal.yourdomain.com, and click Verify.
Stay on the page until Dubsado confirms. If verification succeeds, your custom URL appears; an error usually means the CNAME was not set up correctly, which your domain host has to fix.
